segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: The hearing of the Committee on Finance, Finance Subcommittee G, is hereby called to order.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Our hearing today is the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture, its attached agencies and corporations. We would like to acknowledge the presence of Senator Erwin Tulfo. And may we now call on our Committee Secretary, Attorney Philip Lina, to acknowledge and place on record our resource persons for today.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: You have the floor, Attorney Lina.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Chair. Good morning, Senator Tulfo. In attendance in this budget briefing of the Department of Agriculture are the following: Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.; Attorney Asis G. Perez, Undersecretary for Policy Planning and Regulations; Engineer Roger V. Navarro, Undersecretary for Operations and Agri-Fisheries Mechanization.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Nora C. Oliveros, Undersecretary for Finance; Carlos C. Carrag, Undersecretary for Inspectorate and Enforcement; Engineer Christopher V. Morales, Undersecretary for Rice Industry Development.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Cheryl Marie Natividad Caballero, Undersecretary for High Value Crops; Constante J. Palabrica, Undersecretary for Livestock.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Bureaus, Elisir S. Salilig,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Helen Holgado, also from the same service,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: That's all for now, Mr. Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Mr. Ken Abante, from the People's Budget Coalition.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Thank you very much, Atty. Phillip, our Comsec.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang warning ng pag-asa na posibleng magpatuloy hanggang first half ng 2027

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Tinataya naman ng DA na maaaring mabawasa,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ng mga 700,000 metric tons ang palay production sa second half ng taon

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: dahil sa strong El Nino at iba pang weather-related shocks.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Banta rin ang matinding init at water shortage sa mga livestock, fishpond, at fisheries.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dahil sa mga babalang ito, kailangang paglaanan ng karampatang budget ang irigasyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: imbakan ng tubig, gayon din ang paglalaan para sa agarang tulong sa ating mga magsasaka at mangingisda

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: na ngayon pa lamang ay pinsala na ang inaabot o nararamdaman o nararanasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: By our calculation, ang pagkawala ng 700,000 metric tons

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ng palay ay sapat para sa taonang pangangailangan sa bigas ng tinatayang 3.6 million na mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Isang mahalagang hakbang para sa buong bansa ang pag-aproba sa P171.3 billion na inilalaan ng Department of Agriculture for 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang national budget na ito ang gagamitin para tuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: na makapagtanim at makapagpangisda ang ating mga magsasaka at mangingisda

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: para merong sapat na supply ang ating mga pamilyan at makakayanan ng pamilyang Pilipino ang kanilang susunod na kakainin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Isipin natin itong budget na parang paghahanda sa isang malaking salu-salu sa hapagkainan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At ang iba't ibang ahensya ng DA,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ang ating mga kusinero at bawat isa ay may mahalagang tungkulin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Bigas, gulay, livestock, isda, storage, distribution.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kailangan tiyakin ng DA na iisa ang sinusunod na plano ng lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Hindi problema ang maraming kusinero, problema kapag walang koordinasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kulang-kulang ang mga sangkap at ikanga pagtulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: O pagdating ng damo, napatay na ang kabayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yan ang hamon para kay Secretary ka-tukayo, Kiko Laurel.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Wala pa yung pinaka-impact ng Super El Nino as of September 26.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yet, as of October 6, assistance medyo nagkukulang.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: 2.53 million ang natulungan sa target beneficiaries na 11.2 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang tanong din, hindi ba dapat dahil limang regyon na ang tinatamaan ng El Nino

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: base sa datos ng DA, hindi ba dapat magdeklara na ng National State of Calamity

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Para magkaroon na ng dagdag na suporta at pondo dahil nga narito na ang El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: If I recall correctly, El Nino is already damaging crops and livelihoods in Region 2,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: SOCCSKSARGEN, Region 2, and one more, and Region 5.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: I believe the Executive Department should seriously consider a State of Calamity Declaration

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: so that we can better address the challenge.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dapat maging sentro ng 2027 budget ang tubig at irigasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero tatalakayin pa rin natin ang iba pang mga issue ng Departamento.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yung underutilized funds in the 2026 budget, agriculture smuggling,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: agri-impact ng tuloy-tuloy pa rin gulo sa gitnang silangan, ang Iran-US-Israel war,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: pork imports, mga farm-to-market roads, yung problema sa delay.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: sa pag-implementa ng food hubs, among others.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary Kiko, for your presence and your leadership in the Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We are ready to hear your presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But before that, we give the floor to Senator Erwin Tulfo for his opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ah, mahal na Chairman, Senator Kiko Pangilinan, si Agriculture Secretary Kiko Laurel, Jr.,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: mga kasamahan sa pamahalaan, mga kababayan, magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ngayong araw, ating tatalakay ng panukalang budget ng Department of Agriculture

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: at ng mga attached agencies and corporations nito para sa taong 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Agrikultura po ay isa sa pinakamahalagang sektor ng ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dito, nakasalalay po ang ating pagkain, kabuhayan, ng milyong-milyong magsisakat,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: mangingisda, at sa presyo ng pagkain sa hapag ng bawat Pilipinong pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Under the 2027 NEP, the DA family has proposed total budget of around 198.4 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: composed approximately of 196.9 billion pesos in new appropriations

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and 1.5 billion pesos in automatic appropriations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: itinaas po ito sa 210 billion pesos with 208.5 billion in new appropriations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa pagginig po nating umaga, nais nating malinawan sa ilang mahalagang usapin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Noong nakarang taon, nasaksihan natin ang ating mga hearings sa pangunguna nga po

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ng ating chairman, Sen. Kiko Pangilinan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: kung paano po nagturuan ng DA, Bureau of Customs, at ilang law enforcement agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung sino ang pananagutan sa paghawak, pag-iingat, at pag-dispose o pagsira

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ng mga nakumpiskang smuggled agricultural products.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nalinaw na po ba kung saan nagsisimula at nagtatapos ang mandato ng bawat ahensya?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May malinaw na ba ang chain of custody at accountability upang hindi na maulit pang muli ang ganitong kalituhan?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ikalawa, ang karapatan po ng ating maliliit na mangingisda.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Naging malaking usapin din po sa 2023 decision ng RTC Malabon sa kaso ng Mercedar Fishing Corporation

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: na may malaking implikasyon sa pagpasok ng commercial fishing vessels sa 15-kilometer municipal waters.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Isa sa mga nakitang problema rito ay ang procedural lapses ng BIFAR.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kagagaling ko lamang po sa Mimaropa kahapon, sa Marinduque, Romblon, Mindoro, at Palacios.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Inawan, iisa po ang sigaw ng mga magsasaka o mangingisda.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala na pong nakukuhang isda dahil kinuha na po ng malaking kumpanyang ito ang kanilang dapat sana ihuli.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: They are being forced to go out.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Milya-milya po ang layo para lamang makakuha ng isda.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Samantalang, ang mga fishing companies, ito, corporation na ito, ay hindi na kailangan lumayo pa

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: para ikang mangisda at makakuha ng maraming isda.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang tanong natin, ano ang ginagawa ng BIFAR upang maitama ang mga pagkukulang at maprotektahan ang kabuhayan ng mga maliliit nating mangingisda?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dito po matatagpuan ang International Rice Research Institute.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ngunit nananatili tayong number one importer ng bigas sa buong mundo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: During Marshall Law po, tayo po ay exporter.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ngayon, tayo na po ang importer.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May lupa tayo, may mga magsasaka, may teknolohiya at mga eksperto.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ngunit, bakit hindi pa rin natin matugunan ang sarili nating pangangailangan sa bigas?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kailangan pa natin, ikanga, humingi ng tulong at kumuha sa ibang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ano ang konkretong plano po ng DEA umang mapataas ang lokal na produksyon at mabawasan ang ating pagdidepende sa importasyon?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ikaapat, ang kalagayan po ng ating mga magsasaka, marami pong lumalapit sa aming tanggapan na nagre-reklamo sa napakamahal na presyo ng abono at napakamababang farmgate price ng palay.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Habang hirap na hirap kumita ang ating magsasaka, may mga middlemen at negosyanteng nagpapatong ng napakalaking tubo bago makarating ang produkto sa ating mga mamimili.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dalawang beses na talo ang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Lugi na nga po ang magsasaka natin, mahal pa ang binibili ng consumer.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ano ang ginagawa po ng ating ahensya upang mapababa ang production cost?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Matiyak ang makatarungang presyuhan sa supply chain.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At ang ikalamang problema, ang paghahanda sa napipintong matinding El Niño sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi natin kailangang antayin matuyo ang ating mga sakahan, masira ang mga pananim.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tumaas ang presyo ng pagkain bago tayo kumilos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May sapat na ba tayong plano para sa irigasyon at patubig?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nakapaghanda na ba tayo ng drought-resistant crops, mga binhi at iba pang suporta para sa ating mga magsasaka?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Paano natin titiyaking hindi mauwi sa kakulangan ng pagkain ang matinding tagtuyo?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa ating mga kaibigan sa DA, nais ko pong idein na huwag sana natin gawing palaging dahilan ng kakulangan sa budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung bakit hindi natin nagagampana ng ating mga tungkulin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Taon-taon po, suportado po kayo ng ikang institusyon na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bilyong-bilyong piso po ang inilalaan ng pamahalaan sa sektor po ng agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Karapatan din po ng taong bayan na malaman kung saan napupunta ang pondong ito, paano ito ginagastos at ano ang kongkretong resulta.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi po sapat na mataas lang ang utilization, obligation at disbursement rates.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang mahalagang tanong ngayon ay may napapala ba ang ating mga magsasaka, mangingisda at mamimili?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ito po ay isang hamon sa aking kaibigan, si Sekretary Kiko Laurel Jr.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa madaling salita na is natin makita, hindi lamang ang mga programa at pangako, kundi ang mga resulta at malinaw na pananagutan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Patunay po natin o patunayan po natin sa ating mga kababayan na ang bawat piso ang inilalaan sa agrikultura ay nagagamit ng tama,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: fordoktibo at may buong transparency at accountability. Maraming salamat po, Ginong Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Senator Erwin Tulfo. We now give the floor to Sekretary Kiko Laurel. Do you have an opening statement? Go ahead, Sek Kiko, you have the floor.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Honorable Chairman, distinguished members of the Senate Committee on Finance, colleagues, ladies and gentlemen, good morning.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Today we seek your support for the Department of Agriculture's proposed 2027 Bill.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At the time when our farmers and fisherfolk face a perfect storm, a looming super El Nino, worsening climate risks, and rising costs of fuel fertilizers and vital inputs, pressures compounded by geopolitical shocks beyond our control.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: The Department of Agriculture cannot control the weather or the price of oil halfway around the world, which also affects the price of fertilizers.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But we can decide on how prepared our farmers are.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And we must. We cannot demand cheap food while leaving farmers struggling to afford to produce it.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Nor can we expect our fisherfolks to keep feeding the nation if doing so means their families remain hungry for a better life.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Affordable food begins with viable farms. Food security begins with secure livelihoods.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Our proposed budget is designed to turn these principles into action.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We will continue raising productivity through quality seeds, better inputs and modern technologies, expand farm-to-market roads, cold chain systems, and post-harvest facilities,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: and strengthen links between producers and markets so farmers and fisherfolks earn more from what they produce.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We will also invest in climate resilience, disaster preparedness, and biosecurity.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Because every harvest lost to drought, every fish catch spoiled in transit,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: every crop destroyed by disease is not merely an agricultural setback, it is food lost, income lost, and opportunity lost.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Every peso invested wisely in agriculture can help deliver more than food.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: It can mean more stable prices, stronger rural economies, better paying livelihoods, and greater dignity for millions of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But public investment must come with public accountability.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Government assistance must reach small farmers, fisherfolks, and agrarian communities.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Every program must be measured not simply by how much it spends, but by what it delivers.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Higher productivity, higher net incomes, fewer post-harvest losses, and food that remains safe and affordable.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: In a moment, Undersecretary Aziz Perez will present the details of our proposed budget and investments that will help us meet these goals.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But beyond the figures lies a fundamental choice.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Whether we will continue asking our food producers to do more,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: or give them the tools, infrastructure, and protection they need to thrive.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: A nation cannot eat budget figures, but with the right investments,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: those figures can help put food on every table and a better future within every farmer's reach.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: On behalf of the Department of Agriculture, I respectfully seek the Senate's support for our proposed 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Together, we are committed to a culture that not only feeds the country,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: but also provides a more sustainable future.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: A future that will be more productive and a better life for the people who feed us.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Thank you Mr. Chairman and good morning to everybody.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Thank you very much, Secretary Kiko Laurel.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Before we get on with the presentation by Usec Aziz Perez,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: we place on record and acknowledge the presence of our former Senate President, currently Senate President Pro Temp, Senator Tito Soto.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Go ahead, Usec Aziz, with your presentation of the Department's 2027 proposed budget.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Chair and to the honorable members of this committee.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: It is an honor to present the Department's Agriculture FYI, FY2027 National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Before that, I would like to provide the outline of this presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Before you proceed, we'd like to acknowledge the presence of our Senate President,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Senator Win Gatchalian and Senate President Gatchalian.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: In this outline, before we dive into the details of the National Expenditure Program,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: we would like to provide a brief snapshot of the current situation in agriculture and fisheries sector.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This will provide a broader context of our programs and investments under the NEP.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: After this overview, we will walk through the details of the NEP.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Of the 2.3 trillion GDP in 2025, agriculture and fisheries sector generated around 1.83 trillion, contributing around 7.9% to the overall economy.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: The agriculture and fisheries share has steadily declined from 10.1% in 2020 despite remarkable resilience during the pandemic.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This highlights the need to accelerate growth and strengthen the sector's contribution to the economy.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: In terms of stakeholders, we have 10.44 million registered individuals in our SPSA.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This is broadly consistent with the PSA estimate of 10 million people engaged in agriculture and fisheries,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: or an equivalence of about one for every five workers.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Our registry will provide a clearer picture as shown in the table.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Now, poverty among the farmers and fisher folks has declined substantially over the past two decades.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Yet, it remains significantly higher than the national average.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: In 2023, poverty incidence stood at 27% for our farmers and 27.4% for our fisher folks, compared with 15.5% nationwide.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This indicates that while we have made progress,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: this has yet to be fully translated into improved livelihoods on those sectors who depend on agriculture.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Now, looking deeper into this figure,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: the 7.9% reflects only the value of production at the farm gate,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: but not the much greater value generated when agricultural products are processed, transported, and sold to the market.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: There will be no 55 kilogram of rice in Metro Manila without the palay,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: brought at 19 pesos from the farmers.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: There will be no 366 peso per kilogram liempo if there is no pork produced at 170 pesos per kilogram.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: There will be no 206 per kilogram chicken without broiler.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: The chicken produced at 119 peso per kilogram.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: These figures highlight the important question.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Are we adequately recognizing the contribution of our farmers and fisher folks to the value generated across the economy?

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: We saw the sector importance during the 2020 pandemic when its share in GDP rose to 10.1%, largely because other sectors contracted more sharply.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: When we look at this sector, share in GDP,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: therefore, there is a risk at overlooking agriculture and fisheries in the economic priorities.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: It bears to emphasize that agriculture is the foundational industry.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This is a bedrock upon which many other industries and economic activities depend.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Investing in agriculture, therefore, is not merely investing in the farmers and the fisherfolk.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: It is investing in the strengths, resiliency, and growth in the Philippine economy.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: As we have seen so far, agriculture and fisheries sector creates value,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: yet food insecurity and poverty and vulnerability

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: yet food insecurity and poverty and vulnerability exist among the sector.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: These persistent challenges can be faced to fundamental bottlenecks

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: across the agriculture and fisheries value chain,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: beginning at the resource level where agricultural land is becoming increasingly fragmented,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: with an average size failing from 3.59 hectares to just 0.82 hectares.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This suggests that the only way to move forward is to cluster these farms into economic enterprise

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: to allow what we call the economies of scale.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: At the production level, high input costs and low mechanization continue to constrain productivity,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: with major commodities falling short of their 2025 PDP.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: At the post-harvest stage, we continue to lose significant share of what we produce.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Losses reach 14.5% for rice, 31.6% for onion, and 26.5% for mangoes, as an example.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This shows that the challenge is not only how to produce more, but to prevent losses and preserve them.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: We need to increase the value of production all the way to the market.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Finally, logistics and market access remain constrained by inadequate infrastructure and weak transport system.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: An estimated 55,050 km gap in farm-to-market access

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: and 68,433-pallet [unclear] deficit in cold storage capacity

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: raise transport costs, increase losses, and limit farmers' access to market.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: As mentioned by the Secretary, as if the challenge continues,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: along with this existing challenge, the impact on the conflict in the Middle East,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: particularly on fuel and fertilizer, has increased drastically.

segments.text: A year-to-year comparison of August National Weighted Average of Fertilizer will show

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: a higher prices of 6 out of 7 major grades used.

segments.text: So ito po yung mga figures, sobrang laki na po ng itinaas.

segments.text: Fertilizer prices began rising in the late 2020 as demand recovered from COVID-19,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: while supply chain remained disrupted and energy cost increased.

segments.text: We go to the farmgate prices.

segments.text: We have already expounded on the price of fertilizer and fuel.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Now, notwithstanding the cost or the increase in production cost this year,

segments.text: a year-on-year comparison of June farmgate prices in selected commodities show varying price changes.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: The agricultural sector recorded a trade deficit of around 11.12 billion in 2025.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: But it represents a modest improvement of about 5% compared to the previous year.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: This aligns with the trend observed in 2022 where trade gaps are gradually narrowing.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Supported by raising export alongside moderate import growth.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Despite this encouraging developments, the trade deficit remains substantial.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Bringing this gap will require sustained support for export expansion while aggressively bolstering local farm yields and domestic supply chain.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Looking at the composition of agricultural trade,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: It remains heavily concentrated on just a few commodities.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Coconut products lead toward the average of about 3.6 billion, followed by bananas, at 1.68 billion.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: On the import side, animal and vegetable oils and pot account for the largest,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: followed by fruits and vegetables and animal feeds.

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: Together, these figures underscore the sector's narrow export resilience,

segments.speaker: DA Undersecretary Asis G. Perez
segments.text: reliance and on the handful products alongside substantial widespread demand for foreign food items at critical production inputs.

segments.text: Paano makakatulong itong PAF, in presidential assistance,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: itong worst case scenario na 4 million farmers maapektuhan natin?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Well, Mr. Chair, yung presidential assistance to farmers and fisher folks,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: that is basically cash assistance, direct cash assistance to our farmers who are affected.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Of course, sarami ngayon ang affected at 4.6 million.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But nag-uusap po kami sa kabinete.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: With other, like Secretary of DOLE, Secretary of DSWD,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: na we're pooling now our funds para nga kung may tinamaan ng El Nino na hindi na talaga makatanim

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So may cash assistance, may food packs, may tupad,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: or maybe canal making or land preparation.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So ganun ho ngayon yung diskarte namin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And moving forward to address para hindi yung dekahunt kaming lahat.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: kagaya yung may El Nino sa Camarines Norte na may tinamaan na area na doon,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: na binanggit namin kay Sec. Rex Gachelian,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: nagpadala ko kagad ng assistance ang DSWD in forms of cash din sa kanya dahil meron silang pondo.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kasi mas mabilis mag-respond at mag-replenish ang DSWD.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So parang ganun na ho yung...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: While 10 billion na PATH na ninalagay natin namin for 2027 sa direct cash assistance,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: meron na kami access ngayon sa DSWD through them,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So yun ho yung mas magandang sistema namin ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Later on, meron kaming ginawang special committee for economic recovery.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And we included, si Majority Leader Migs,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: include niya na rin doon yung El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So hingi kami ng detailed briefing on the government's response to El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And it can be as worse as the Iran conflict in which yung presyo ng langis tumaas.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ito naman, triple whammy. Wala ka ng trabaho, wala ka ng output, wala pa tayong makakain.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So we really need to make sure na ang gobyerno ay handa pagdating sa El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And so far, narinig ko kanina sa inyong briefing na meron na kayong parang whole of government approach.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: To conserve resources between DOLE, DSWD, and DA.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ganun ba ang approach, Secretary, to itong mga vulnerable sectors?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. Not only that, pati sa DOH, meron din tayong collaborative with DOLE, DOH, DSWD, and maybe other agencies pa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: OCD pala, pati sa OCD under the DND.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Aside from PAF, what other components in the budget na gagamitin ninyo to respond to El Nino?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Meron din tayo, Mr. Chair, fuel assistance, of course, some fertilizer support, seed support, and transport support, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yung logistic support na, like sa tollways, meron tayong mga agreement, and hopefully we can get more funding for that, among others, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So that's embedded already in the budget ng DA?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And on a detailed submission na lang, pakisubmit na lang, Secretary, yung DA's response to the El Nino.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll jump to another topic, Secretary, and ito na pag-usapan natin last year, yung farm-to-market roads.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung farm-to-market roads, nabigay, o tinransfer namin ni Senator Kiko, siya being the chairman of the budget of the DA, to the Department of Agriculture instead of the Department of Public Works.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But nakita ko dito sa utilization for 2026, hindi pa siya nai-utilize to date.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, may we get a briefing on...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Tapos yung concept na yun, tinransfer natin sa DA, and then second, base dito sa aming report, doon sa 33 billion na farm-to-market roads, wala pang nagagawa for 2026.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Before you answer, just to place on record, we'd like to acknowledge the presence of our minority leader, Senator Alan Cayetano.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: May transfer na ho sa amin yan, at may mga conditions under the GAAD for the transfer that we had to set up several offices, you know, get more people together.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: May delay kami sa requesting of SARO.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But of course, na-request naman yung SARO namin, I think, by mid-year this year.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But then, yung pera, dumating din lang September.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At then, nung binigay sa amin yung pera ng September,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: it's an end of a quarter that we had to give it back, no?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At inire-release lang ulit ngayon yung pondo sa amin this October.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But on the positive note naman, Mr. Chair, we're ready to bid now.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: At finally, matutuloy na ho yung implementation ng FMR natin for 2026.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And for 2027, pag na-approve na ho sa BICAM na yan,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: pre-procurement basis sa NEP and short of award

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: so that magmapabilis namin yung implementation yan sa 2027 also, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Itong 33 billion na FMR, kaka-transfer lang sa inyo, kaka-release lang ng SARO itong September?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Actually, ang na-release lang sa amin is 4.2 billion, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Tapos binalik namin yan, we had to return it dahil may end of the month cut-off kami.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Then binalik naman sa amin by this October lang yung 18 billion out of the 33, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So magkano na ang na-release for 2026 lang?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And doon sa special provisions in which si Sen. Kiko ang nagsulat nun,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: may mga requirements, for example, yung transparency, ilalagay sa portal, ilalagay sa website.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, naka-setup na ho at ready to go.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So now, the challenge, nandito na yung challenge namin na maayos to at nakita na lahat ng tao how we perform.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And I have required actually our team sa DA to give a monthly report.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: To me, on the status of each and every project with pictures, which I will also copy the committee chairman, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, during the last hearing, it was a challenge to you.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil doon sa DPWH, iba-iba yung presyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But I remember during that time, you said the DA can construct it more efficiently and much cheaper through the BAFE.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I, ano ba ito, na-increase ba yung capacity nila?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi yun rin yung isang worry namin, baka mabulunan yung BAFE, DA BAFE.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Have you already capacitated yung BAFE?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Well, we have increased its capacity but not enough, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But it will be a challenge.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: It's not, hindi ito magiging madali but we will do our best.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We assigned a special undersecretary just to look into all of this team para may nakatutok na 100% so that we do it properly.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Yung sa presyo naman, at that time, we can make it lower.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: As of now, bumalik kami sa original considering naman na prices of everything has gone.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But we were able to maintain yung dating presyo at 15 million per kilometer

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: which even yung contractor, sinasabi, medyo maliit na yung margin nila

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: but payag naman na kailangan lahat ng trabaho at kailangan ng projects naman ng mga contractors.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So for normal, on a normal condition, 15 million per kilometer pa ba ang cost?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sa ngayon, yun ang tamang cost na yun.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Of course, as you inspected, may iba nasa Bangil, di ba?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But on the average, assuming all things equal, 15 million ang cost.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll just ask some more questions on my second round.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Senator JV, Chairman of the Committee,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Good morning to Secretary Laurel, the DA family.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This was asked earlier, no, ng ating po, Senate President,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: yung tungkol po sa Presidential Assistance to Farmers and Fisher Folk Program,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: being the Chair of the Committee on Finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I noticed, as pointed out by our Senate President,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: wala po ito sa NEP, but it was included in the House,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: HGAB, or General Appropriations Bill from the House,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Just want to ask, did the agency request it for this?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: O ang house ang naglagay nito?

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Nung pinapareho namin yung aming NEP, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: we were given kasi a cap, fiscal cap.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, hindi namin sinama yung PAF initially,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: but sa Congress, even actually sa Senate,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: i-request namin talaga na may dagdag yan,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: dahil nga, it's the looming El Nino.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, kung madadagdagan pa yan, would be better,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: but then, pwede rin naman dagdagan yun sa DSWD,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: kasi nga, now we're working together naman eh.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: But we really have to prepare for El Nino,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: lalo na sa ating farmers and fisher folk.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Well, actually, when I first reviewed the HGAB,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: nakita ko kasi, I got worried that the fund for the NDRMC,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: for the calamity fund, natanggal na 9.5 billion,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but I saw this is a new entry.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But when you said also na tingin din namin na para naman ito siguro,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: direct assistance to farmers and fisher folk,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in anticipation of El Nino, okay din kami.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And I agree with the House on this matter especially,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pero doon sa iba, medyo may mga ayusin pa namin,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but with this, with your endorsement also,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: tsaka kanina, napaliwanag yun naman kung paano nyo ito gagamitin,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in anticipation of the super El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Although NIA is not anymore under the Department of Agriculture,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: si Katari, nabanggit mo kanina yung ano, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I propose to NIA to concentrate more on water impounding

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and retention projects in the coming years, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because every time, every rainy season,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pero kung wala naman dadaloy na tubig, sayang din.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: While you just like to ask for your opinion or position on this,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: do you think this will be a better choice?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because I think we'll be hitting two birds with one stone here.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We will be mitigating flood also.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, it will be for flood mitigation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At the same time, we will have the needed water during the dry days,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: especially now na meron tayo mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yung ilin ninyo na, as mentioned earlier,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Instead of the usual, sabi nyo kanina, ten years,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, would you also endorse or suggest that we pursue that direction

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: of having more impounding, having more...

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Along that, pati aquaculture will thrive, sir.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Definitely, nung pumasok ako, Mr. Chair, sa DA,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I already mentioned to many na

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: we are actually throwing away water.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kung ang Palawan, mas manipis pa.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kung humulan ho sa gitna ng Palawan,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: ang tubig na ulan na yun, in 12 hours na sa dagat na.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Sa Luzon naman, ang calculation ko,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: kung humulan sa gitna ng Luzon, kung may linya sa gitna,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: ng malakas, in 48 hours na sa dagat na yung tubig na yan.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Kung lalagyan ho natin ng halaga yung tubig na humulan

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: I computed it at 500 billion pesos a year yun.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: A worth of water ang tinatapon natin.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: So, ang ganda ho ng inyong push, Senator JV, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: and I fully support na kailangan talaga natin ng warm water impounding.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: We have so much water to impound and we should impound it.

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: And NIA, in my opinion, should concentrate on the big ticket items

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: like dams, water impounding, and all the major canals

segments.speaker: DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
DA Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
segments.text: Water waste for our agriculture, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you for that, Secretary Laurel.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I also suggested that instead of us concentrating on this flood mitigation project,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: or dating flood control, flood mitigation,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para nangyari sisementohan lahat ng ano,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: lahat na pwedeng simentohan nating water waste,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para mawala lahat ng tubig, ma-push back,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: wibilis lang yung takbo ng tubig para itapon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: hindi pa na reprelish yung groundwater,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, I think this has to be the,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: dapat magkaroon ng convergence ang NIA and DPWH

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we will be retaining more water on dry days.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, thank you for your opinion.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'm happy that you support this,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and thank you for your support and for the direction.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sabi ko kaya yung mga sabo dams,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: dapat ganoon siguring gawin natin from the upland.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and even for, of course, for irrigation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: very tightly in our fiscal space,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As Chairman of the Committee of Finance, siguro basic lang, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Which of the programs would you appeal that be funded, na dapat ituloy?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because yung halimbawa, pati bare minimum na rin na kailangan nyo sana,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I would like to find out, na increase in budget, kasi nga napakasikip.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Very, ano tayong elbow room natin, but then again, we would like to find out as Chairman of Finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: na we do not want the productivity of the Department of Agriculture to be affected.

segments.text: But, fortunately, tamang-tama lang po yung tanong ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Well, that's good news for our local production, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Let me move on to, ano, of course, that one, another sector that is close to my heart because coming from Negros, I saw Sir Paul Alcaza Ascona here, SRA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: My mother coming from, who hails from Negros, of course, sugar industry is very close to us.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: SIDA has a mandated annual funding allocation under the law.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yet funding has always fallen short. Under the 2027 NEP, 1 billion

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: is allocated to the SRA with the limited budget of SIDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How can we ensure that the full intended budget for SIDA programs is actually released and properly utilized to help our sugar cane farmers?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, so far, for the last...

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: Prior to 2022, our SIDA budget went down to as low as 300 million, 500 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona

segments.text: I think almost 500 million kasi na-unutilized ever since before.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: And for the last three years, we've tried our best to spend yung previous po.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: So, we've been spending over 1 billion for the last two years.

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona
segments.text: And hopefully, if given 2 billion, we will be able to fully utilize it, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: SRA Administrator Pablo Luis S. Azcona

segments.text: Anyway, I'm hoping that we'll be able to overcome this RSSI problem and super-el-lino.

segments.text: the Senate and even the executive agencies have proven to be more open to receiving civil society feedback.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ini-emphasize po namin ito dahil ito ay isang critical na step to restoring the broken public trust in the budget process brought by the flood control scandal.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Citizens like us who are directly affected by reforms have the right and responsibility to engage in every step of the budget process.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kaya po na-appreciate po namin ito dahil sa komiting ito, na-appreciate po namin yung pagka-specific ng plano ng DA at ating Senado sa El Niño,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: which brings us, nag-uusap po kami dito ni Tim, who represents farmer and fisher folk organizations,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: it brings us a lot of comfort and confidence that government will do something about their experiences.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: that this engagement becomes the norm in Congress and even include the scientific institutions who specialize in these reviews.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So salamat po sa paikinig sa mga hinain ng Trillion Peso March at Baja sa Luneta Rallies.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Meron po kaming tatlong obserbasyon at rekomendasyon na gusto pong ibahagi tungkol sa Department of Agriculture Budget.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Una po, billion-billion po ang in-insert ng House of Representatives sa Department of Agriculture Infrastructure Budget.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nananawagan po kami sa Senado at sa Ehekutibo

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: na tulungan po kaming i-review ang lampas 7,054 projects worth 190 billion pesos na in-insert ng House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nire-request po namin ang DA at ang Senado sa pag-publish ng mga dokumentong ito for media and civil society to see the documents following these red flags.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang warning po namin sa publiko, if we allow the House budget to pass as is, we might get another flood control scandal but in another age.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ikalawa pong major finding namin sa citizen monitoring, we commend the Department of Agriculture for their Farm-to-Market Road Watch

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: and we could recommend po that we strengthen and explore opportunities with our Bisto Proyecto Network

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: which has already networks in 12 regions to extend the identification and monitoring of farm-to-market and irrigation projects with farmer and fisher folk groups.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: The third major finding is we recommend investing and involving scientists and scientific institutions.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: in the budget review process to even strengthen the additional requirements for El Niño and promoting the stability of agriculture prices.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nire-recommenda po namin sa komite na i-include ang mga scientists, hydrologists, disaster resilience experts from Project NOAA,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: agriculturists and ecologists from UPLB to review the DA as a whole.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Gusto po namin isa-isahin yung tatlong rekomendasyon na ito.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Una po, sa mga house insertions sa farm-to-market roads.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Naniniwala po kami, at nag-usap po kami ni Sec. Kiko kanina po before the hearing,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: naniniwala po kami na kailangan naman talaga ng farm-to-market roads, irrigation projects at agricultural investments

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: para po sa El Niño, mga bagyo, at para po mapababa ang presyo ng ating mga bilihin.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Pero po, kapag in-insert ng House of Representatives ang 7,000 projects worth 190 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: kasama po sa mga in-insert ng house, ang 15 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: sa farm-to-market and irrigation projects na walang publicly-posted project attachments.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang house po, nag-insert ng 355 na totally new projects worth nearly 6 billion pesos for farm-to-market roads

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: na totally wala sa National Expenditure Program at Proposal ng DA.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ito po ay yung mga tigpa 5 million, 10 million, 15 million na mga kalsada.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Hindi po tayo sigurado kung konektado ito talaga.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: National Highway Network o konektado ito sa mga resort nila.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: The house inserted 319 totally new irrigation projects worth 9.4 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And the egregious thing about these house insertions is they do not have the same level of public disclosure

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: that was given by the Department of Public Works and Highways.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nag-publish po sila ng mga geotagged photos, program of works, detailed unit price analysis,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: certificate of implementability ng mga local government units,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: feasibility studies at local development council approvals.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kaya po siguro bahagi po ito kung bakit nag-slow down ang farm-to-market road budget utilization

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: kasi po kailangan po yung lahat ng dokumentong ito ay present before even the budget is approved.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Yung even more details, kailangan pong i-publish hindi lamang ang coordinates pero yung mga supporting documents.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Halimbawa po, kailangan pong i-review ang mga coordinates ng proyekto.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: meron po kaming mga angry nerds.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ito po yung 5,500 volunteers, the best software developers in the world

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: who got politically active after the flood control scandal.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We mapped every single project, every single of the 18,000 projects that are now in the House bill.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May mga nakita po kaming 23 million pesos na farm-to-market road na dapat ay nasa Nueva Ecija

segments.text: pero ang coordinates po ay nasa Karagatan na malapit sa Benham Rice.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May isang 30 million pesos na farm-to-market road na dapat ay nasa Nueva Ecija.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May isang 55 million pesos na farm-to-market road na dapat ay nasa Cebu pero nasa Celebesi, malapit sa Indonesia.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May isang 55 million pesos na farm-to-market road na dapat nasa Quezon pero nasa Karagatan, malapit sa Brunei.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kailangan din po natin i-review ang cost assumptions sa iba-ibang infrastruktura sa farm-to-market at irrigation.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kanina po nasabi na 15,000 pesos per meter or 15 million pesos per kilometer ang market price ngayon dapat ng mga kalsada.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May mga koordinates na published na 19 million pesos per meter dahil 2 meters lang po ang nasa koordinates or 6 million pesos per meter.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Sa tingin po namin may mga mali sa mga koordinates na ito na napasa both in the NEP and the House version.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: At ang nire-request po ng aming angry nerds ay yung mismong raw data, yung mga GeoJSON shape files para ma-verify po ang lahat ng ito.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: In the middle of some of these project cost analysis that we did,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: may mga nakita pa po kaming mga 33,000 pesos per meter at 20,000 pesos per meter.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Gustong sabihin po, if we take the budget as is, may mga likely overpriced projects pa rin po sa DA.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ikalawa naman po, tinignan namin ang irrigation projects.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Meron po ba kaming nakita na mga solar panels at kung ano man ang mga naging assumption sa mga solar pump irrigation projects.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Concerned po kami sa costs ng solar pump irrigation systems with AI capability.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Na bilog-bilog na 50 million, 100 million, o 200 million ang mga budget para rito.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: There is a risk that these projects may be overpriced so these must be reviewed.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Tinignan po namin kung magkano dapat ang 600 to 700 watt solar panel.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Dapat po ito ay under market prices just 7,000 pesos.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: But some bidding and detailed unit price analysis documents are team reviewed.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nakita po na yung solar panel costs na ito, actual bidding documents coming from the NIA,

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So we want to ask whether these are still the same cost assumptions being used for the irrigation projects under this budget.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Meron din pong mga AI monitoring section ang mga proyektong ito.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Dapat po ba talaga ay merong tigo 1 million pesos per lot na AI monitoring?

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Hindi po ba dapat mas centralized na ito?

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Again, we are not saying that these are conclusive of corruption because we need more documents to make a determination.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang sinasabi lamang po namin, kailangan po ng determination at kailangan ng dokumento para po magkaroon tayo ng mas maayos na review.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Pinublish po namin ang findings na ito.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We have a listing of all 18,000 house projects in this link, bit.ly or bit.ly slash budget red flags.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Iniimbitahan po namin ang media, civil society, at ang kongreso at akademya to work with us on these inspections.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Kung ang eleksyon po ay may disiplina ng eleksyon.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Sa budget naman po ay dapat may budget monitoring.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: So yun po yung first major finding namin sa NKICO and SPWIN.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ikalawa po is an offer to support the great work of Secretary Kiko Chulaurel and the DA family.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We commend the DA for launching the Farm to Markets Roadwatch.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Nakita po namin na sa DA may website sila na inupload ang 3,455 completed projects of 6,428 projects worth 110 billion pesos.

People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: However po, when we saw the public reports in your e-reports portal, only 24 reports have been submitted by citizen inspectors.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Ang offer po for support namin, we think we can support the citizen monitoring of these farm to market roads.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And perhaps we can work with the Bisto Proyecto group convened by Cardinal Ambo David and Dondon Parafina.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: Our more than 200 volunteers, mga nanays ng 4Ps, Rover Scouts, mga madre at pare,
