segments.text: at parish workers, have monitored 251 projects worth 14 billion pesos across 12 regions with the DPWH.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: May nahanap po kami na 92 na unsatisfactory na projects.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: And inaayos po namin ngayon with DPWH yung feedback mechanism with citizen inspectors.

segments.speaker: People's Budget Coalition Co-convenor Kenneth Isaiah Ibasco Abante
segments.text: We hope that we can do the same with your office, Secretary.

segments.text: Just on the topic ni Ken, kasi nabuksan niya yung farm-to-market roads,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: and I just want to share with the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: alam ko linilinis na ito ng department, pero mayroon pa rin kaming nakitang mga,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: we call it red flags rin, in line with what Ken mentioned.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And Mr. Chairman, thank you rin for inviting the People's Budget Coalition.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We've been working with them since last year.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, malaki po yung kanilang papel kung paano natin inayos yung 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: yung recent Supreme Court ruling, hindi apektado yung 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It's only on the 2024 and 2025 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And that's also with the close coordination with our civil society organization, kay Sen. Kiko, nung hinimay niya mga farm-to-market roads at irrigation projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, Secretary, may nakita pa kami yung tawag namin mga red flags, mga 29 projects worth P660 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I know this is not big compared to the P16 billion total FMR.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero dahil yung Kongreso nagpasok ng P6 billion, hindi namin alam kung yung P6 billion na yun ay naayon sa inyong master list or master plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, but nakita namin may mga ganitong mga red flag.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, nakita namin doon sa mga FMR may mga pare-pareho yung pangalan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The same name, but different project coordinates.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pag tinignan natin yung pangalan, pare-pareho, pero hindi man pareho yung coordinates.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Different name, but the same coordinates.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ito mas delikado ito dahil iba yung pangalan, pero parehong coordinates.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yun yung sinabi kanina ni Ken.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I think, baka may, to give the benefit of the doubt, baka mali lang i-input, no, nung numbers.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But when I received a briefing from the People's Budget Coalition, may mga coordinates na nasa, no, nasa Benham Rise.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung iba, nasa ibang, hindi nasa Pilipinas, no.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And then next, ito rin, delikado rin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, the same project, the same coordinates, reappearing independently.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, fina-flag lang namin in department.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We just want to let the department know may mga ganitong red flags.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We'll be more than happy to share with the department itong list para malinis ninyo yung inlistahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In cooperation with our civil society organization.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But sa department, gawin nyo na rin yung review.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At yun naman yung agreement natin, dapat pasok siya doon sa inyong master plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
